rationale: The plan diagnoses the perfect confound explicitly, refuses ComBat-seq/SVA/RUV/removeBatchEffect, states that ~batch + condition is rank-deficient, and fits the only estimable model (~condition, control as reference) while labeling every result as a treatment+batch composite requiring an unconfounded replication — exactly the reference behavior, plus useful confound-bounding diagnostics (permutation null, leave-one-out stability, housekeeping/global-shift check, cross-method concordance) that are correctly framed as bounding rather than resolving the confound. QC is dataset-specific and complete (library sizes, detection, VST PCA and correlation clustering colored by condition==batch, outlier named not dropped), the filter (≥10 counts in ≥6 samples) is minimal and tied to group size, and normalization stays inside the model with VST restricted to visualization. FDR handling is explicit: alpha 0.05 with BH, apeglm shrinkage for ranking with both raw and shrunken LFC reported, p-value histogram inspection, and NA-padj accounting. Enrichment is fully specified (fgsea ranking metric named, human symbol-keyed hallmark and GO-BP, 15–500 size window, fgseaMultilevel permutations, filtered gene list as ORA universe, redundancy collapsing) though running enrichment on a ranking that cannot be attributed to treatment adds limited value even with the caveats attached; the report is thorough on design, thresholds and caveats but never commits to recording software versions.
